commands: (command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1 && dnf -y install amazon-efs-utils nfs-utils git httpd php php-cli php-common php-mysqlnd php-gd php-xml php-mbstring php-intl php-json php-zip php-opcache mariadb) || yum install -y amazon-efs-utils nfs-utils git httpd php php-cli php-common php-mysqlnd php-gd php-xml php-mbstring php-intl php-json php-zip php-opcache mariadb

cat > /etc/httpd/conf.d/moodle.conf <<'EOFV'
<VirtualHost *:80>
  DocumentRoot /app/moodle
  DirectoryIndex index.php index.html
  <Directory /app/moodle>
    AllowOverride All
    Require all granted
  </Directory>
  ErrorLog /var/log/httpd/moodle_error.log
  CustomLog /var/log/httpd/moodle_access.log combined
</VirtualHost>
EOFV
# Mount using EFS helper with TLS/IAM
if ! mountpoint -q /app; then mount -t efs -o tls,iam "${APP_EFS_ID}:/" /app || echo 'mount /app failed'; fi
if ! mountpoint -q /data; then mount -t efs -o tls,iam "${DATA_EFS_ID}:/" /data || echo 'mount /data failed'; fi

if command -v mount.efs >/dev/null 2>&1; then grep -qE "^${APP_EFS_ID}\.efs\.${REGION}\.amazonaws\.com:/\s+/app\s+efs" /etc/fstab || echo "${APP_EFS_ID}.efs.${REGION}.amazonaws.com:/ /app efs _netdev,tls,iam 0 0" >> /etc/fstab; fi

if command -v mount.efs >/dev/null 2>&1; then grep -qE "^${DATA_EFS_ID}\.efs\.${REGION}\.amazonaws\.com:/\s+/data\s+efs" /etc/fstab || echo "${DATA_EFS_ID}.efs.${REGION}.amazonaws.com:/ /data efs _netdev,tls,iam 0 0" >> /etc/fstab; fi
# Fetch Moodle code (clean) and reset config
if [ ! -f /app/moodle/index.php ]; then rm -rf /app/moodle 2>/dev/null; git clone https://github.com/moodle/moodle.git /app/moodle; fi
cd /app/moodle; git fetch --all --prune; git checkout MOODLE_500_STABLE || true; git reset --hard origin/MOODLE_500_STABLE || true

DB_SECRET_ARN=$(aws secretsmanager list-secrets --region "$REGION" --query "SecretList[?contains(Name, \"Moodle\") || contains(Name, \"Db\") || contains(Name, \"DB\")].ARN" --output text 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -n "$CREDS" ]; then DB_USER=$(echo "$CREDS" | jq -r .username); DB_PASS=$(echo "$CREDS" | jq -r .password); DB_NAME=$(echo "$CREDS" | jq -r .dbname); fi
# Drop existing Moodle tables for a clean install

for t in $(mariadb -h "$DB_ENDPOINT" -u "$DB_USER" -p"$DB_PASS" -D "$DB_NAME" -e "SHOW TABLES LIKE 'mdl_%';" 2>/dev/null | grep mdl_); do mariadb -h "$DB_ENDPOINT" -u "$DB_USER" -p"$DB_PASS" -D "$DB_NAME" -e "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS $t;" 2>/dev/null || true; done

sudo -u apache php admin/cli/install.php --lang=en --wwwroot="$ALB_URL" --dataroot=/data/moodledata --dbtype=mariadb --dbhost="$DB_ENDPOINT" --dbname="$DB_NAME" --dbuser="$DB_USER" --dbpass="$DB_PASS" --dbport=3306 --prefix=mdl_ --fullname="Touchstone Institute" --shortname=TSI --adminuser=moodle-admin --adminpass=TempPass123! --adminemail=it@tsin.ca --non-interactive --agree-license || echo 'CLI install failed'
